title: The dark string of lights
prompt: Three bulbs in series on 9 V stay dark. A meter reads 9 V across bulb 2 and 0 V across bulbs 1 and 3.
explanation: The open part is the one with the full supply across it: bulb 2. Bulbs 1 and 3 read 0 V because no current flows.

lines: No light, so no current flows
With no current, working bulbs drop 0 V
The full 9 V appears across the break
So bulb 1 is the open one, because it reads 0 V
